root_cause: Version incompatibility cascade: uni2ts 2.0.0 requires torch<2.5 (have 2.15.0) + specific pytorch_lightning (have 2.1.4) + GluonTS predictor has pydantic v1 batch_size validation error + MoiraiModule not recognized as LightningModule + forward() needs pre-patched inputs from the broken transform pipeline.
predictor_blocked: GluonTS PyTorchPredictor pydantic v1 batch_size validation error
trainer_blocked: MoiraiModule not recognized as LightningModule by pytorch_lightning 2.1.4
forward_blocked: Needs pre-patched inputs (multi-resolution patching from transform pipeline)
how_to_fix: Use exact uni2ts-compatible versions: torch>=2.1,<2.5 + pytorch_lightning compatible version + pydantic v1 compatible gluonts. Requires separate venv with ~10GB disk.
minimum_requirements: Separate venv with torch<2.5 + compatible pytorch_lightning + gluonts + uni2ts
